environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the Flask app behind an Application Load Balancer with path-based routing. Container image based on python:3.11-slim with pandoc 2.19 installed. Task role has s3:PutObject for report storage. Container runs as root. No additional request filtering or input validation middleware. Environment variables: VALID_API_KEYS=prod-key-abc123, TEMPLATE_DIR=/opt/templates. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards X-API-Key header. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB and port 8080 from ALB SG on the task.
